sentence.text: Printed on harde-treated cloth, kut develops a deep fast chocolate-black as iron reacts with the tannic acid.

questions.prompt: Natural _____ is fermented in an underground vat; a vat need only be made once and can be kept active, sometimes for decades.

sentence.text: Natural indigo is fermented in an underground vat; a vat need only be made once and can be kept active, sometimes for decades.

citations.quote: An indigo vat need only be made once, then used daily and ingredients replenished to keep the Vat active, sometimes for decades.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 7

citations.quote: Natural Indigo is purchased in blocks or cakes, ground to a powder and soaked before fermenting in an underground vat consisting strong alkaline lime powder, dates and carbonate of soda, plus specialty ingredients unique to each particular dyer.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 7

sentence.text: Cloth is boiled in a solution of tamarix (dhawri) with madder, al or alizarin.

citations.quote: But for some ajrakh, alizarin (synthetic madder) may be used, in which case the cloth is boiled in a solution of alizarin and tamarix powder.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 6

citations.quote: The cloth is boiled in a solution of tamarix (from the dhawri tree) and either madder root powder or al root powder and is then washed and sun-dried.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 6

sentence.text: The final wash is usually done early in the morning when water is cool, as warm afternoon water may dissolve some of the alum.

citations.quote: It is usually done early in the morning when the water is cool as the warm water of the afternoon may dissolve some of the alum.It clears the excess dyes and makes the whiteness of the Ajrakh stars shine bright.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 8

citations.quote: Final Wash (Vichharana):The final washing and beating to remove any loose colour is vital.
citations.locator: GI Journal No. 188 copy (application 1050), PDF p. 8

sentence.text: Alum solution fixes colour and also helps remove the dabu paste; its quantity varies with the strength of the dabu.

citations.quote: This solution is then strained through a cloth filter. Quantity of alum varies according to the strength of the dabu.
It is washed again and then rinsed in a solution of alum and water to fix the colour and also for removing dabu paste.

sentence.text: Alum (karam in Telugu) is pounded, boiled in water until reduced to half, and iron implements are avoided because iron darkens the colour.

citations.quote: The solution is allowed to boil with occasional stirring until it has reduced to half. A mixture of iron in any form leads to darkening of the color and for this reason the iron implements and utensils are avoided.
Alum (Karam in Telugu) Dry alum crystals are pounded to powder. Water is added in the proportion of 4 liters water to 3.5 kilograms alum.

sentence.text: Chhipas came perhaps more for abundant water with excellent properties for dyeing and printing than for royal patronage; the Sanjaria river's perennial stream and sandy bed suited printing.
